title: Where The US Is (Still) Exceptional

Where The US Is (Still) Exceptional

Tan Kai Xian, Cedric Gemehl

Gavekal Research | 18 Sep 2026

Compared with European stocks, US stocks are no longer exceptional. Over the past four years, there has been no sustained trend in the relative performance of the two, as measured by MSCI mid and large-cap indexes (see Neither US Exceptionalism Nor A European Boom). Having said that, drilling down to the sector level, US consumer discretionary and staples stocks have continued to outperform their European counterparts. This suggests that while the US market in general is no longer exceptional, US consumers remain exceptionally resilient in their choices and spending patterns. Looking ahead, they appear likely to remain so.
